art_note: The product photography relies heavily on flat 2D mockups and composite templates, lacking the sophistication of a high-end luxury fashion house.
desc_en: Redefine nighttime leisure with this fluid silhouette. Crafted from a lightweight fabric with an ultra-soft feel, these shorts balance effortless comfort with understated elegance. Featuring an elastic waistband designed for everyday wear, subtle functional pockets, and a delicate lace trim along the hem that introduces a touch of timeless refinement. An essential piece for intimate moments of relaxation at home. Made to order with worldwide shipping.
desc_es: Redefina el descanso nocturno con esta silueta fluida. Confeccionados con un tejido ligero de tacto ultrasuave, estos shorts combinan comodidad y elegancia discreta. Presentan una cintura elástica diseñada para el uso diario, sutiles bolsillos funcionales y un delicado remate de encaje en el dobladillo que aporta un toque de refinamiento atemporal. Una pieza esencial para momentos de relajación íntima en el hogar. Hecho bajo pedido con envíos a todo el mundo.
